Supporto ai Team Leader: Gestione operativa delle richieste quotidiane, delle segnalazioni e degli aggiornamenti provenienti dai Team Leader.

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Chi sei
Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

Ore: Tempo pieno

Retribuzione

La normativa ci chiede di indicare una base retributiva di partenza, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

postings.title: People Operations Specialist (data & projects) H/F
postings.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.


Ce que tu fera : 
1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

- 

piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

- 

simplifier et améliorer nos process

- 

construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

- 

construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

- 

automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

- 

identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

- 

participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

- 

accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

- 

l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

- 

la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

- 

le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

- 

les questions des managers et des salarié·es

- 

le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

- 

le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

- 

tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

- 

tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

- 

tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

- 

tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

- 

tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

- 

tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

- 

tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

- 

tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

À l'inverse il n'est pas fait pour toi si ..
Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

- 

un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

- 

un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

- 

un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

- 

un poste purement tech

- 

un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !
Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

postings.title: Plumber (London)
postings.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology.
We started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 
Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front. And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers, whilst building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.
At Octopus Energy Services, we’re building a passionate team to drive the green energy revolution across the UK (and beyond). From heat pump engineers and electricians to solar specialists and smart meter installers, our field teams deliver outrageously good, in-home customer experiences. Behind the scenes, sales, support, fulfilment, logistics, and data experts keep everything running smoothly - fuelling innovation across our supply chain. We move fast, think differently, and care deeply about what we’re building. If you're passionate about making a real difference - bingo, you're in the right place.
Our field teams are the people you will see during your smart home installs and the people driving those fancy pink vans on the road!
We specialise in bringing green energy to customers through our awesome smart home technology but with the incredible customer service you expect from Octopus. We cover smart meters, heat pumps, solar, batteries and EVs with plenty more to come!
This is where you come in - in order for us to continue to provide these incredible services - we need incredible people!


We're looking for plumbers who have experience in heating systems and are passionate about providing our customers with the best service possible (we’ll provide full training to help you transition over to renewables). You'll be the face of Octopus Energy in our customers' homes backed by a strong track record of safety, respect and top-tier service, you’ll love connecting with customers just as much as handling the technical work.




You'll be responsible for:
- Working as part of a team of two to install low carbon technology in customers’ homes, starting with Air Source Heat Pumps. 

- Using your knowledge and experience of domestic heating and plumbing systems to prepare and install unvented cylinders, pipework, and radiators 

- Planning and communicating with the wider team and customers 

- Continuously learning about new technologies at our innovative R&D training centre

What do we need from you?
- Minimum Level 2 NVQ in: Plumbing and Heating or Mechanical Engineering Services - Plumbing (domestic) AND/OR Gas Qualified with CCN1 and CENWAT, held for a minimum of three years

- Experience on the ‘wet’ side of domestic heating systems

- Full UK driving licence with no more than 6 points

Other qualities we'd love to see include:
- A laser customer focus - communication is key 

- A proactive, ‘can do’ attitude 

- A keen eye for detail and problem-solving skills 

- WRAS Water Supply Regs or UHW10/HWSS Unvented DHW Storage Systems can also be beneficial but not essential!

Join us in the Octoverse!
- £30,000 base salary with overtime available (+ London weighting if living within M25) 

- £2,500 annual performance bonus 

- Share Options in Octopus Energy 

- £25 per week lunch allowance 

- Training programme at our groundbreaking R&D centre 

- Use of company tools, uniform and all PPE 

- Company Vehicle and fuel 

- Support for personal development in Renewable Tech

Why else you'll love it here
• Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
• Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
 
 
If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first🚀
 
P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at talent@octoenergy.com and we’d love to help!
 
Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
 
Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

postings.title: Poseur·euse de panneaux photovoltaïques H/F
postings.description:
Chez Octopus Energy Services, nous concrétisons la transition énergétique directement sur le terrain. Nos équipes interviennent chez les particuliers pour installer des panneaux photovoltaïques.


Tes missions seront : 
- 

Réalisation des installations : Pose des pattes de fixations, travaille des tuiles en fonction de leur matière et positionne les panneaux photovoltaïques conformément aux plans fournis et dans le respect des normes en vigueur.

- 

Sécurité et travaux en hauteur : Sécuriser intégralement le chantier avec les EPI/EPC indispensables. Utilisation de matériel de levage. 

- 

Aide au raccordement et contrôle qualité : Réaliser le passage des câbles, exécuter les raccordements nécessaires au travail de l’électricien et valider vos interventions via un rapport interne pour garantir une prestation irréprochable.

- 

Gestion du matériel : Gérer votre stock de matériel pour anticiper les besoins et travailler en étroite collaboration avec vos coéquipiers pour assurer l'efficacité du chantier.

- 

Relation client : Assurer un contact professionnel et pédagogique auprès des clients.

Profil recherché :
- Travailler en hauteur n’est pas un problème pour toi

- 

Expérience : Couvreur avec une première expérience réussie sur le terrain. 

-

postings.title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
postings.description:
About the role
Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections.
This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you.


What you'll do
- Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders.

- Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation.

- Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration.

- Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project model across plant, substation, civils and enabling works, with value engineering and optioneering. Then FAT/SAT witnessing, commissioning plans and sequences of operation, energisation and handover.

- Take on what you haven't done before. First-of-a-kind means no precedent, no standard design and no colleague who's done it. Get to a working understanding of an unfamiliar technology or scope fast, and deliver it.

What you'll have
- Master’s degree, or equivalent, in electrical or power systems engineering. CEng welcome, not essential.

- 5+ years delivering energy or infrastructure projects, with a strong grounding in MV and HV systems.

- Real infrastructure experience - substations, networks, industrial plant, data centres, utilities, water or transport. We care that you've dealt with ground conditions, easements, consents, tie-ins to live assets and construction sequencing. This is not a grid-only role.

- You've personally held a programme and a budget on a development or pre-construction project.

- A GB/European grid connection taken from connection offer to grid code compliance and energisation, with working knowledge of the Grid Code, CUSC, SQSS, G99/G100, ENA engineering recommendations and BS 7671.

- Able to coordinate a multi-discipline design where you're not the expert in every discipline - and to spot a weak answer from a civil or mechanical engineer.

- Comfortable as the single point of accountability with an incomplete picture, holding external parties accountable without formal authority.

- Full UK driving licence and willing to travel to site.

It would be great if you have...

BESS, private wire, microgrid or behind-the-meter generation; data centre or mission-critical power (MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, redundancy topologies, commissioning levels); study tools (ETAP, PowerFactory, IPSA, PSS/E, PSCAD) or Python; IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA and metering data flows; NEC or FIDIC contract and change management. Project management credentials (APM, PRINCE2, MS Project, Primavera) - though we care far more about what you've delivered.

Once you're in the interview process with one of our recruiters, it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

postings.title: Renewals Expert
postings.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing 
 
Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.
 


You will be joining our newly established Driver Success Team, a dedicated team responsible for maximising
customer retention and satisfaction at the end of their lease agreement. 
 
Existing customers are not 'new leads'; they require a strategic, relationship-based approach, not a standard sales call. 
 
Your goal will be to convert upcoming lease renewals, win back 'controllable' leavers, and renew relationships by resolving issues directly, ensuring a great experience that encourages drivers to stay.
 
This is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week based in our Weybridge office.


What you'll do
Your primary focus will be on relationship management, retention, and turning customers into advocates:

- Actively manage the pipeline of end-of-lease customers, advising and supporting them through the renewal of their electric vehicle lease.

- Manage renewals, end-of-lease extensions, and retention across all of our leasing products, including salary sacrifice, consumer, and BCH offerings. This will require a strong understanding of the varying finance products available and the ability to confidently manage and adapt to different customer types across each product line.

- Engage with long-term customers, focusing on a relationship-based approach to understand their experience and future needs.

- Proactively work to win back lost customers, repairing relationships, and converting 1-star experiences into 5-star renewals, turning detractors into advocates.

- Take ownership of a shared team goal, actively working with your peers to deliver the highest possible % Renewal Rate for the business.

- Following up with all customers in a prompt manner and matching drivers with their ideal car based on their needs.

- Be customer obsessed, through consistently demonstrating next level care, understanding, and service to ensure drivers have every reason to stay and continue their journey with us

What you'll need
- A genuine passion for customer experience and a strong commitment to doing the basics well for a great customer experience, and want to retain our customer base.

- The ability to match drivers with their ideal next car and clearly articulate the benefits of continuing their lease.

- Solution focused approach to challenging conversations, especially when dealing with customers whose previous service experience has fallen short of expectations.

- Positively contribute to team culture and actively share knowledge and ways of working, supporting a team based goal structure.

- A proactive attitude towards taking ownership of your own learning and trying to find answers independently

Why else you'll love it here 
- 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

- 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

- 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership

Things to note
- P.s. 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies

- 

🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

About us 
 
The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
 
We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
 
Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
 
We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.


Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
 
Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

Bei Octopus Electric Vehicles (OEV) Germany gestalten wir die Mobilität der Zukunft direkt am Arbeitsplatz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die gerne beraten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam etwas Neues aufzubauen.

Wir bauen Octopus EV in Deutschland gerade auf. Du gestaltest also von Anfang an mit, wie gute Beratung bei uns aussieht. Dabei entwickelst du unseren Beratungsprozess weiter, bringst deine Ideen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Erfahrung für unsere Kund*innen einfach, persönlich und gut wird.


Deine Aufgaben:

Dabei begleitest du sie empathisch und kompetent von der ersten unverbindlichen Anfrage bis zur Bestellung ihres Wunschautos.

Vertrieb und Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus den Beratungsgesprächen ein, um unsere Vertriebsprozesse und Beratungstools für den deutschen Markt kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Begeistern und präsentieren: Du behältst deine Gespräche und Kontakte im CRM im Blick und führst überzeugende virtuelle Informationsveranstaltungen für Mitarbeitende durch.

Was du mitbringen solltest:
Beratung mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Du kannst komplexe Themen wie Versteuerung und Reichweite verständlich und anschaulich erklären. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und findest gemeinsam mit Kund*innen die passende Lösung ohne ihnen etwas „aufschwatzen“ zu wollen.

Lust auf Neues: Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl und packst gerne mit an. Wenn noch nicht alles perfekt organisiert ist, findest du pragmatische Lösungen und hilfst dabei, unsere Abläufe weiterzuentwickeln.

Hoher Anspruch an Service: Du weißt, dass du nicht einfach ein Auto vermittelst, sondern einen besonderen Mitarbeitenden-Benefit begleitest. Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und eine persönliche Beratung sind dir wichtig.

Begeisterung für nachhaltige Mobilität: Du interessierst dich für E-Mobilität und kannst deine Begeisterung authentisch mit anderen teilen. Dabei musst du kein Technikprofi sein. Wichtiger ist uns deine Neugier und dein Interesse an nachhaltiger Mobilität.

Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift, da du direkt mit Mitarbeitenden unserer deutschen Partnerunternehmen kommunizierst. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit unserem internationalen Team.

Deine Gehaltsspanne:
Fixum: 45.000 - 55.000 €/Jahr (Brutto)

Provision: 7.500 €/Jahr (Brutto; OTE; uncapped)

Deine Benefits bei uns:
 
✅ Vergünstigungen & Vorsorge:
- Nachhaltig unterwegs mit unserem E-Auto-Leasing
- Aktienoptionen der Octopus Energy Group Ltd.
- Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Nahverkehrsticket
- Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
- Vergünstigtes Fahrradleasing
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 
✅ Familie
- Beratungsangebote und Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung über HeyNanny
- Monatlicher Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung
- Elterngeld-Bonus: Wir stocken dein Elterngeld für 3 Monate auf, damit du deine Elternzeit entspannter genießen kannst 
 
✅ Sport & Gesundheit
- Zuzahlungen zu Fitness- Angeboten über Wellpass
- Förderung deines mentalen Wohlbefindens mit unserem Partner Open Up
 
✅ Lernen & Weiterbildung
- Attraktive Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten
- Kostenlose Sprachkurse über Busuu
 
✅ Extra Goodies
- Gutschein zu deinem Geburtstag 
_________________
 
 
 
Du findest die Stelle super spannend, bist dir aber unsicher, ob du alle geforderten Skills zu 100% erfüllst? Bitte zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben!
 
P.S.: Octopusse gibt es in allen Farben, Formen und Größen. Wir freuen uns auf Mitarbeiter*innen jeden Geschlechts, Alters, jeder sexuellen Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, mit und ohne Behinderungen. Für uns zählt nur eins: du passt zu uns und brennst darauf, etwas zu verändern.

postings.title: Senior Account Manager
postings.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing 
 
Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.
 


We are seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team in London, tasked with driving the commercial success of valuable customer relationships.

You will step into a pivotal role, taking full ownership of a high-value enterprise portfolio offering our market-leading EV salary sacrifice scheme. You will be responsible for building multi-year growth plans, managing commercial risks, and securing maximum scheme adoption and long-term retention.

This role requires strong gravitas, expert commercial acumen, and an unwavering commitment to translating our mission of sustainable transport into quantifiable success for both our corporate clients and Octopus EV.
 
Please note that you must hold a valid UK driving licence.

This role is based in our Oxford Circus office. We’re pretty flexible, to do this role well we think you need to be in for minimum x2 days per week. 


What you'll do...
- 

Drive portfolio growth. Own the account strategy and performance of the largest, most complex and strategically important accounts. Define and execute yearly account plans focused on maximising scheme penetration and expanding the relationship across all areas of the customer’s company.

- 

Act a strategic thought leader. Consult with senior stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance, Sustainability) to architect their long term EV benefit or company car strategy. Translate the customer objectives into joint opportunities for scheme success from initial pitch (where you will act as an influencer alongside the BD team), through onboarding and sustained high level adoption.

- 

Own the smooth running of the account. While your focus is strategic growth, you will be the ultimate owner of the account. This means personally tackling and resolving client escalations, navigating internal roadblocks, and alongside our Scheme Delivery team ensuring the scheme's day-to-day operations run flawlessly. 

- 

Help shape the Account Management team. You'll be a key part of how the account management team evolves, bringing your gravitas and positive communication to internal meetings and working groups. This means actively coaching and supporting our rising talent, leading by example with your proactive approach and excellent results, and sharing those 'lightbulb moment' learnings that make us all better. 

- 

Cultivate Executive Partnership & Influence. Develop and deepen trusted, senior relationships, positioning Octopus EV as an indispensable partner in the customers’ long term business strategy. 

- 

Ensure Strategic Account Integrity. Take full ownership of long-term account health and retention. Proactively design risk mitigation strategies for regulatory, commercial, or operational challenges, maintaining maximum scheme participation and minimising churn across your entire portfolio.

- 

Lead Cross-Functional Alignment. Act as the primary internal voice of the strategic client portfolio. Direct and align internal teams (Product, Operations, Finance) on client requirements and solutions, ensuring the delivery of a seamless, high-quality experience that meets the needs of major corporate customers.

- 

Leverage Data for Strategic Influence. Analyse portfolio data and share customer insights to quantify OEV's value to the customer and proactively influence the OEV Product roadmap and operational processes. 

- 

Build expert-level knowledge. Build a deep understanding of your customer businesses, the industry, market risks and opportunities and link this to strategic plans for your portfolio, and future risks and opportunities for Octopus EV.

What you'll need...
- 

Deep Commercial Experience (6+ years). Progressive, relevant experience in enterprise account management or another relevant commercial role, ideally within a B2B2C environment or where the revenue model is based on usage of the product

- 

Accountability for Strategic Growth. Highly results-accountable, with evidence of exceeding growth and penetration targets and proactive risk mitigation across a high-value portfolio. 

- 

Advanced Commercial Acumen. Financial literacy and strong commercial acumen used to reach win/win outcomes. Proven ability to lead negotiations with senior finance and procurement stakeholders.

- 

Executive-Level Partnership. Demonstrated maturity and gravitas essential for building deep, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Proven ability to influence internal and external strategy and secure buy-in across large, complex organisational structures.

- 

Complex Problem Solving. Operate with autonomy, taking full ownership of portfolio performance. Proven ability to design and implement robust solutions for commercial or operational challenges that could impact the entire OEV customer portfolio.

- 

Thought Leadership & Senior Communication. A highly articulate and compelling presenter and communicator. Able to confidently present strategic plans and performance reviews to a varied audience.

- 

Driving Client Value. Deep passion for client success, with a track record of quantifying and communicating tangible ROI and long-term quantifiable benefits back to clients, ensuring Octopus EV is viewed as an indispensable strategic partner.

- 

A Scale-Up Mindset. Demonstrated ability to thrive and lead within a fast-moving, scale-up environment. Able to adjust to change, handle ambiguity, and proactively shape and influence internal process improvements and commercial strategy to support business growth.

- 

Industry Knowledge. A genuine passion for sustainability and the EV transition. Knowledge of the EV, employee benefits, and/or automotive leasing markets is a ‘nice to have’.

💚 Why else you'll love it here 
- 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

- 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

- 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership

Things to note...
- 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies

- 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

About us 
 
The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
 
We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
 
Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
 
We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.
 


Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
 
Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

postings.title: Senior Accountant
postings.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 


IL RUOLO
In Octopus Energy la contabilità è una funzione dinamica che comprende la realtà aziendale e le sue evoluzioni e monitora costantemente l'andamento dei numeri, non solamente in corrispondenza delle chiusure mensili o della predisposizione del bilancio.

In qualità di Senior Accountant, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team Finance per presidiare giornalmente i flussi contabili. Il cuore del tuo lavoro sarà la gestione dei movimenti contabili, l'analisi delle dinamiche dietro ai numeri e la costruzione di controlli e riconciliazioni solide che tengono la contabilità sotto controllo in ogni momento.

È una posizione che richiede curiosità e contesto: una figura contabile generalista e completa, che padroneggia le regole e le logiche contabili e sfrutta queste conoscenze per evolvere i processi, rafforzare i controlli interni, affiancare il team nell'operatività quotidiana e contribuire a costruire una struttura accounting sempre più robusta e scalabile.

COSA FARAI
- 

Gestione della contabilità: presidio quotidiano delle scritture contabili (con particolare riferimento a quelle inerenti la contabilità generale) applicando in autonomia sia i principi contabili nazionali (OIC) che internazionali (IFRS)

- 

Monitoraggio e controlli di bilancio: controllo costante dei conti contabili durante il mese, analisi delle movimentazioni, capire perché e come si muovono le grandezze contabili, riconciliazioni delle principali schede contabili per identificare tempestivamente anomalie e opportunità di miglioramento

- 

Processo di chiusura e reporting: responsabilità attiva e coinvolgimento diretto nei principali processi di reporting: chiusure mensili, redazione del bilancio d’esercizio annuale e gestione attiva delle attività di revisione contabile

- 

Adempimenti fiscali: gestione continuativa degli adempimenti fiscali ordinari e periodici

- 

Process Improvement & Automazione: analisi e ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e dei processi contabili interni, individuando dove l'automazione crea valore e, laddove possibile, realizzandola in autonomia per rendere le attività del team sempre più ordinate ed efficienti e aumentare l'affidabilità dei dati

- 

Accounting excellence: collaborazione con i colleghi del team Accounting per migliorare i processi contabili, evolvere le metodologie di stima delle grandezze contabili, ridurre l’operatività che non porta valore e introdurre modalità di lavoro sempre più efficienti e strutturate

CHI SEI
- Hai fatto contabilità in prima persona: hai padronanza completa di tutti i principali cicli e processi contabili, usi quotidianamente i gestionali contabili, sai cosa vuol dire registrare i movimenti contabili, ricostruire un movimento e non solo coordinare chi lo fa

- Hai conoscenza e padronanza dei Principi IFRS & OIC

- Non ti accontenti di effettuare una registrazione contabile perché qualcuno te lo ha chiesto: vuoi capire il perché dietro i numeri e ti infastidisce scoprire i problemi in ritardo

- Hai esperienza nella definizione di controlli e processi contabili, anche in assenza di infrastrutture sofisticate

- Lavori bene in autonomia e porti ownership: non aspetti che qualcuno noti un problema per occupartene, sei una persona abituata a mettere le mani in pasta su qualsiasi aspetto della contabilità, con visione d'insieme e spirito di iniziativa

- Sai leggere un bilancio in relazione al business e comunicare i numeri in modo chiaro a chi non vive la contabilità ogni giorno

- Hai lavorato in contesti dinamici o in crescita, dove le procedure non erano già tutte scritte e c'era da costruire mentre si correva

- Hai familiarità con i moderni strumenti informatici, attitudine all'innovazione e interesse per l'ottimizzazione continua dei processi

- Aver lavorato in società di Audit/Big Four rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese

- Aver già maturato esperienza nel ruolo

PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE QUI
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell'azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un'azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l'impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

COS'ALTRO TI PIACERÀ QUI DA NOI
- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

- Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

- Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

- Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

QUALCHE DETTAGLIO IN PIÙ
• Sede: Milano

• Ore: Tempo pieno

• Presenza in ufficio: Sì

Retribuzione
RAL a partire da 42.000 €

La normativa ci chiede di indicare una base retributiva di partenza, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

Aiutaci a portare la rivoluzione Octopus in Italia: inviaci il tuo CV e raccontaci qualcosa di te.
Alcune ricerche mostrano che certe persone, in particolare le donne, tendono a candidarsi solo quando soddisfano tutti i requisiti richiesti. Ma se questo ruolo ti entusiasma davvero anche se pensi di non avere proprio tutti i requisiti richiesti, candidati lo stesso: potresti essere esattamente la persona che stiamo cercando.
In Octopus vogliamo lavorare con persone perbene, oneste ed empatiche. Le nostre persone sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la varietà di prospettive che ognuno porta è ciò che ci permette di crescere. Non facciamo distinzioni di alcun tipo: offriamo le stesse opportunità a tutti, in un ambiente equo e accogliente.
Crediamo che molte competenze si possano acquisire, mentre passione, potenziale e voglia di imparare fanno davvero la differenza. Per questo valorizziamo i percorsi di crescita e la diversità di genere a tutti i livelli.

postings.title: Senior Analytical Engineer H/F
postings.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Nous recherchons un•e Senior Analytical Engineer expérimenté•e et motivé·e pour rejoindre l’équipe data transverse au sein d’Octopus Energy France. 
La fonction data en France regroupe une quinzaine de data analysts, de data scientists et de data engineers, embarqués•es dans différents domaines métiers. Cette équipe transverse s’assure de construire des fondations solides, partagées et fiables.
Tu rejoindras cette équipe dans laquelle tu travailleras sur les fondations analytiques, la couche sémantique et la gouvernance de la donnée. Il s’agit d’un rôle transverse qui sera en interface avec les besoins métiers et des autres praticiens•nes data.
Tu seras en charge de renforcer et développer nos fondations data afin de fluidifier le travail de l’ensemble des métiers et praticiens•nes data.
 
Ainsi, tes principales missions seront les suivants : 


Modélisation de données et couche sémantique : 
- 

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des modèles de données partagés, au service des besoins métiers (notamment financiers) et de la direction

- 

Être un point de référent technique pour l’ensemble des équipes financières et achats d’énergie

- 

Structurer et organiser la gouvernance de données afin de garantir une seul et même source de vérité

Assurer la qualité de données et les standards : 
- 

Être garant de la qualité de nos modèles de données via la diffusion des bonnes pratiques et le suivi de la qualité de nos données

- 

Éviter les redondances et l’accumulation de dettes techniques afin d’avoir un lineage propre.

- 

Gérer les incidents sur nos modèles les plus critiques

Animer et faire monter en compétence la communauté data : 
- 

Animer ou co-animer des formations, du coaching et des routines dédiés aux équipes data

- 

Être moteur de la transition IA de notre stack: création de skills, démonstration d’exemple et de cas d’usage

- 

Assurer la qualité du code via les revues de code (PR reviews) sur les modèles dbt et les requêtes SQL produits par les autres praticiens data

Assurer la coordination internationale : 
- 

S’assurer de la cohérence et être le relais des pratiques communes du groupe Octopus Energy

- 

Contribuer à l’amélioration de nos modèles partagés

Profil recherché : 
- 

Expérience & Compétences techniques

- 

Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en analytical engineering, data engineering analytique, ou analytics avec une forte orientation technique

- 

Maîtrise avancée de dbt : expérience sur des projets de taille réelle, avec gestion de la structure, de la documentation et des tests

- 

SQL expert — capable d'optimiser des requêtes complexes sur un data warehouse moderne (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks ou équivalent)

- 

Tu es à l’aise en Python pour l'automatisation et les scripts analytiques, en connaissant les bonnes pratiques de développement

- 

Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données et les pratiques de gestion programmatique de ces outils (ex.: “dashboard-as-a-code”).

- 

Tu as une bonne connaissance des patterns d'architecture analytique : Kimball, Data Vault, Medallion, ou hybride — et surtout du pourquoi derrière chaque choix

- 

Expérience en gestion de la qualité de données

- 

Parcours académique en statistiques / mathématique / économie, diplôme spécialisé en data, ou en école d’Ingénieur avec une forte appétence en Data

- 

Appétences et Compétences interpersonnelles

- 

Rigueur et souci du détail : la qualité de la donnée commence par la qualité du code

- 

Pédagogie et envie de faire monter les autres en compétences pour éviter de créer des silos

- 

Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement décentralisé : tu dois convaincre par la qualité de ton travail et la clarté de tes recommandations auprès des praticiens·nes data

- 

Tu aimes les environnements dynamiques: Octopus Energy évoluent vite et les besoins peuvent changer

- 

Notre stack:

- 

Visualisation: Lightdash et Streamlit

- 

Modélisation: dbt

- 

Lakehousing: Databricks (sur AWS)

- 

Orchestration: Airflow

- 

Code: Git

- 

IA: Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini

- 

Langues: tu maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit pour interagir avec nos collègues internationaux

Ce que tu trouveras ici : 
- Un rôle avec une vraie surface d'impact transversale en travaillant sur une communauté data d'une quinzaine de praticiens actifs — tes décisions techniques affectent l’ensemble de la data d’Octopus Energy France. La culture Octopus Energy valorise l'autonomie et la responsabilité individuelles.

- 

Le poste est basé à Paris avec 3 jours de présentiel et 2 jours de télétravail

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !
Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. postings.title: Senior Data Systems Lead
postings.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.
 
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.
 
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.
OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team 
We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. 
Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. 
By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization.
We're looking for a Senior Data Systems Lead who can help drive this.


What You'll Do
- 

Integrate the systems our business runs on - third-party providers, internal tools, our own SharePoint and Microsoft 365 tenant - into our existing Databricks environment, via APIs and existing connectors. 

- 

Build data products on top of what you connect: well-modelled, documented, reusable datasets that the business consumes directly through Excel, dashboards and natural-language querying, rather than one-off extracts. 

- 

Design and ship internal applications and AI-enabled tools - using Python, Streamlit, Databricks Apps (HTMX), Lakebase, FastAPI or similar - that put data and AI directly into the hands of fund management, asset management and finance teams. 

- 

Prototype, evaluate and productionise new AI capability, from document AI and retrieval to agentic workflows, and turn the ideas that prove out into supported products rather than abandoned experiments. 

- 

Take an adopt-first approach: work with Octopus Energy Group's data platform and AI teams to reuse capability that already exists, and configure it for OEGEN rather than building parallel versions of it. 

- 

Set up practical guardrails inside Databricks and Unity Catalog - schema and workspace access, permissions, environment hygiene - so more teams can use it without stepping on each other. 

- 

Bring cost management from reactive to proactive: tagging, budgets, alerting and usage monitoring, so Databricks and AI token spend can be attributed to the right team, project or fund before the invoice arrives. 

- 

Get our AI usage properly credentialed and logged - managed keys and access rather than API keys sitting in individual password managers - and provide clean patterns for embedding AI into the tools we build. 

- 

Standardise how we build and ship internal apps: shared templates, authentication, deployment and documentation, so a tool remains supportable by someone other than the person who wrote it. 

- 

Consolidate the ad-hoc scripts, spreadsheets and no-code workflows we've accumulated into fewer, better-understood integrations that don't need babysitting, and automate the repetitive parts of our own workflow. 

- 

Work directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into things we can build.

What You'll Need
- 

Strong systems integration experience - connecting business systems, SaaS tools and data sources via REST APIs, connectors and authentication flows. 

- 

A track record of building and shipping data products or internal applications that people actually use, not just pipelines that feed someone else's reports. 

- 

Solid Python and SQL, used daily for building, automation and data modelling. 

- 

Hands-on experience with a cloud data platform in production (Databricks preferred): workspaces, catalogs, permissions and compute. 

- 

Practical experience integrating AI into real tools - LLM APIs, retrieval, agents - with a clear-eyed sense of what works and what's still a demo. 

- 

Practical identity and access experience - SSO, service accounts, credential management and access lifecycle - enough to make sensible, secure choices without a security team holding your hand. 

- 

Experience with Microsoft 365 / SharePoint integration, or a comparable enterprise document and collaboration stack. 

- 

Real experience keeping cloud or AI usage costs under control: you know what drives the bill and how to attribute and cap it. 

- 

A pragmatist's instinct for adopting over building where infrastructure is concerned - you'd rather configure something that exists than write something new - paired with a bias toward shipping when it comes to solutions. 

- 

Clear communication. You can explain a trade-off to a fund manager and hold your own in a technical review with a central engineering team. 

- 

Comfort with real ownership in a small team, where you set the working patterns rather than inherit them.

Bonus Points For
- 

Full-stack or application development experience, particularly with Streamlit, FastAPI or HTMX. 

- 

Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem - Unity Catalog, Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Genie - or equivalent tooling. 

- 

Experience with vector search, embeddings, document AI or retrieval-augmented generation in production. 

- 

Experience with Terraform, GitHub Actions or similar, to keep configuration version-controlled and repeatable. 

- 

FinOps experience: usage monitoring, budgets, showback and chargeback. 

- 

Having supported analysts and non-specialist builders using a shared data environment. 

- 

Experience in a regulated or audited setting such as financial services, infrastructure investment or energy. 

- 

Familiarity with renewable energy, infrastructure investment or financial services data.

postings.title: Senior Financial Accountant H/F
postings.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e Senior Financial Accountant (comptable senior) capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.


Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie

- Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers

- Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation

- Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive

Fiscalité énergie et TVA

- Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA

- Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE

- Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes

- Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting

Supervision et contrôle

- Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)

- Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations

Structuration et amélioration continue

- Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre

- Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite

- Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles

- Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

Ce que l'on attend de toi 
De ton arrivée à 3 mois :

- Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office

- Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin

- Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre

De 4 à 6 mois :

- Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales

- Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils

- Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)

Au-delà de 6 mois :

- Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

Ce poste est fait pour toi si
- Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise

- Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus

- Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes

- Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée

- Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée

- Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni

Ce qui fera la différence :

- Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas

- Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer

- Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite

- Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !
Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

postings.title: Senior TechOps Architect
postings.description:
We’re really excited to be building a small, thoughtful and effective TechOps team at Octopus.
 
We’re looking for a knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Architect to help shape how we support people across the business - someone who can lead with clarity, build with empathy, and bring a mix of technical depth and sound judgment.
 
There’s loads to get stuck into, from identity management and scripting to device management and scalable tooling, areas where most of our work sits and where we need thoughtful, sustainable solutions.
 
You’ll play an important role in shaping how we work: setting direction without overcomplicating things, supporting the team with care, and balancing technical curiosity with a down-to-earth mindset. We’re after someone who can spot where things could be better, help others grow, and make improvements that stick.
If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems and shaping how TechOps supports a growing, people-first business – we’d love to chat.
 
What is TechOps?
A more modern, more lean version of a traditional enterprise IT team. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. 
 
We focus on advising rather than enforcing, and give people the autonomy to work with technology to solve their problems in the way that works best for them. We’re an autonomous team who look after a wide range of technology across the business. We empower teams to do the best work they can whilst keeping things running efficiently in the background. 
 
We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company.
 
We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here!
 
About the role As a TechOps Architect,
You will be responsible for high-level strategic and architectural technical decisions around the business. We also strongly believe that no matter what role you have within TechOps, it’s still important to keep your ear to the ground and see, first hand, the problems our users are facing, and the impact that decisions you make have on everyone at Octopus. This means you’ll spend some of your time helping out with day-to-day “1st, 2nd and 3rd line” support.
 
You’ll have a wide breadth of knowledge and experience across all areas of IT, but also an immensely deep understanding of many of those areas too. You’ll likely be an acknowledged expert among your peers in Identity and Access Management, and have a passion for hacking and building. You will have interest and/or experience in related areas like software engineering, security, platform architecture, UI/UX design etc. 
 
Roles that you might currently be in:  IAM Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead/Senior Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Systems Architect, Systems Designer, Senior Systems Engineer, Workplace Technology Architect, Solutions Architect.

- Define what good looks like for a small and lean TechOps team.

- Tackle some of the toughest technical issues as we scale to tens of thousands of people.

- Make wide-scale strategic technical decisions across the whole Octopus Energy Group, globally.

- Design, build and continually improve processes, automations and systems that will improve user experience, remove inefficiencies, allow us to scale quickly and keep our team small.

- Mentor the wider TechOps team, providing support and guidance for any technical project they may be working on. (This role will not involve directly managing people).

- Support the rest of the team in providing delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems.

- Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience.

- Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware.

- Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business.

Examples of some TechOps projects include…

- Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider mac OS and Windows MDM migration

- Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution

- The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors

- Office fit-outs, including tech like network infrastructure, AV and access control SaaS migrations for acquisitions, including Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace

What you'll need...
- Experience leading on a range of technical projects across various technologies and platforms.

- Experience with scripting, using APIs and automating mundane, error-prone repetitive tasks.

- To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time.

- Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders.

- Experience supporting, managing and deploying applications to macOS, Windows, iOS and Android devices.

- Experience with Munki and AutoPkg for macOS software deployment
